crs: GCJ-02 (working interpretation, not a per-response CRS declaration)
crsEvidence: DataV states its map components primarily use GCJ-02 and recommends GeoAtlas for administrative boundaries; provider does not specifically certify every vertex in these files.
coverage: All 34 province-level units in this version of the provider roster; all immediate children for 27 provinces/autonomous regions. Four municipalities and Hong Kong/Macao use their own province polygon; Taiwan has no subregions in this snapshot and is province-only. Includes province-administered county-equivalent units as their own codes; not a contemporary official code register.
snapshotLimit: For example, the Xinjiang file includes 659001–659010; 659011 and 659012 are not separate units here. Simplification, vintage, coastal gaps, overlaps, sovereignty and border interpretations limit precision. Geometry is not redistributed.

sources.use: province roster (not used as city polygons)
